lines.prompt: Remap the entire design to use only NAND and NOT gates. Make sure nothing changes functionally.

golden.reference: Remapped the design to the NAND/NOT basis: 4,547 off-basis gates matched and rewritten; functionality preserved.
golden.notes: Must claim successful remap to NAND+NOT only (no residual OR/NOR/XOR/XNOR/BUF/AND) and functional preservation. All four teams matched/remapped 4547 gates. Post-remap totals are implementation-dependent: Team2/3 delta 13045 added gates (Team3 mis-words it as a 'reduction of 13,045 gates' but still scored full - the sign wording is not graded); Team7 reports NOT=13333, NAND=23123 after remap. Output netlist must be equivalence-checkable vs original.

lines.prompt: Try to replace all 2-input NAND gates that have one input tied to constant 1 with inverters. Ensure the design functionality does not change.

golden.reference: The rewrite NAND(x,1) -> NOT(x) found no matching gates; the design is unchanged and functionality is preserved.
golden.notes: All four full-score teams report 0 matching NAND gates with a constant-1 input, so the correct outcome is 'attempted, nothing to replace, design unchanged'. Response must claim the attempt succeeded (0 rewrites is fine) and that functionality is unchanged. Claiming a nonzero number of replacements would contradict all anchors and should be treated as suspect.
